import itertools

pigeons = 7
holes = 6

# Check all possible assignments (holes^pigeons)
found = False
solution = None
for assignment in itertools.product(range(holes), repeat=pigeons):
    if len(set(assignment)) == pigeons:  # all holes distinct (at most one per hole)
        found = True
        solution = assignment
        break

print("Found:", found)
